parameters.url: =https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal/daily/point?parameters=T2M,PRECTOTCORR,RH2M,WS10M&community=AG&longitude={{ $('✅ Location Validator').item.json.longitude }}&latitude={{ $('✅ Location Validator').item.json.latitude }}&start={{ new Date(Date.now() - 30*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,'') }}&end={{ new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,'') }}&format=JSON

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO weather_data_cache (latitude, longitude, location_name, weather_data, climate_data, planting_calendar, forecast_date, expires_at)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.location.latitude }},
  {{ $json.location.longitude }},
  '{{ $json.location.name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.weather_forecast).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.climate_summary).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.planting_calendar).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  CURRENT_DATE,
  NOW() + INTERVAL '3 hours'
)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
